verdict.rationale: Runpod documents two official MCP servers (API MCP and docs MCP) that connect AI tools/coding agents to Runpod, and runtime probes confirm both are live: the docs MCP completes a full keyless handshake, and the API MCP correctly enforces the documented OAuth flow. This is Runpod acting as a service provider exposing an MCP server, not an agent client, so the axis clearly applies and is delivered with first-party docs plus independent runtime verification. Missing for 10: no third-party/community usage reports of agents actually connecting via these MCP servers in practice.
